data.name: CMA Examination
data.organizer: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
data.description: The CMA examination system of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India covers Foundation, Intermediate and Final courses under the Institute's current curriculum and examination regulations.
data.eligibility_summary: Eligibility depends on the course level. The CMA pathway includes Foundation (10+2 pass), Intermediate (Graduation or CMA Foundation pass), and Final stages, with progression and examination eligibility governed by ICMAI regulations.
data.exam_dates: Conducted twice yearly in June and December

data.name: Joint Entrance Examination Main (JEE Main)
data.description: Joint Entrance Examination Main (JEE Main) is conducted by the National Testing Agency for admission-related purposes covering B.E./B.Tech, B.Arch and B.Planning routes. Paper 1 is also used as an eligibility test for JEE Advanced.
data.eligibility_summary: Candidates who passed Class XII or an equivalent examination in 2024 or 2025, or are appearing in 2026, with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects. There is no age limit for JEE Main.
data.exam_dates: Session 1 in January; Session 2 in April

data.name: Joint Entrance Examination (Advanced)
data.description: Joint Entrance Examination (Advanced) is the entrance test for admission to undergraduate engineering, science, and architecture programmes at the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs).
data.eligibility_summary: Top 2,50,000 successful candidates in B.E./B.Tech. paper of JEE Main. Maximum of two attempts in consecutive years.
data.exam_dates: Typically held in May or June

data.name: RBI Grade B Officer Examination
data.organizer: Reserve Bank of India Services Board
data.description: RBI Grade B is the Reserve Bank of India recruitment examination for Officers in Grade B (Direct Recruit). Selection process comprises Phase-I Online Examination, Phase-II Descriptive Examination, and Interview.
data.eligibility_summary: Graduation in any discipline with at least 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD) or post-graduation with at least 55% marks. Age 21 to 30 years.
data.exam_dates: Phase I typically in September; Phase II in October

data.name: Common Law Admission Test (CLAT)
data.description: The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) is a national-level entrance examination for undergraduate (BA LLB) and postgraduate (LLM) law admissions across 24 National Law Universities in India.
data.eligibility_summary: For UG: 10+2 with minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST). No upper age limit. For PG: LL.B. degree with minimum 50% marks.

data.name: CA Final Examination
data.organizer: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
data.description: CA Final is the pinnacle qualifying examination stage of the Chartered Accountancy course conducted under ICAI's New Scheme of Education and Training.
data.eligibility_summary: Passed both groups of CA Intermediate examination, completed prescribed practical training, Advanced ICITSS course, and qualified self-paced online modules.

data.name: Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG)
data.description: CUET UG is a single-window entrance examination for admission to undergraduate programmes in Central Universities and participating state and private universities across India.
data.eligibility_summary: Candidates who have passed Class 12 or equivalent or appearing in 2026. University-specific age and subject criteria apply.

data.name: RRB Technician Examination
data.description: RRB Technician is a Railway Recruitment Board competitive examination for Technician Grade I Signal and various categories of Technician Grade III posts across Indian Railways.
data.eligibility_summary: Technician Grade I requires prescribed diploma or degree in engineering. Technician Grade III requires Matriculation/SSLC plus ITI/Act Apprenticeship in relevant trades.
